story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify inbound Eligibility, Assessment, and Maintenance dates for effective-date selection
Use Eligibility Date for new enrollment when eligibility span has not yet begun
Use Assessment Date for current eligibility change when Assessment Date changes
gaps: TC_TS003_003 Status field is "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Quoted Expected Results include "The file shows normal technical processing in TM and can be evaluated for business outcome without a technical intake failure." and "No new Assessment Date-driven transaction effective date is applied, no extra FACETS eligibility row is created for the submitted unchanged Assessment Date condition, and the existing record remains unchanged."

scenarios.title: Use Assessment Date and preserve relevant field values when only Assessment Date changes
gaps: Status field is "Negative" for id "TC_TS004_002", but scenario type is positive-only: "type": "Positive"
Negative scenario is off-topic to the acceptance criteria in Name/Description: "Verify AR PASSE inbound 834 does not use Assessment Date when a relevant field also changes"
Edge case lacks an Expected Result describing an error, rejection, or absent record; Status field is "Edge" for id "TC_TS004_003"

Example non-qualifying Expected Result text in Test Step Expected Result: "The transaction may process technically, but there is no evidence of a new Assessment-Date-driven eligibility update because the Assessment Date did not change."

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date for relevant field changes received before eligibility start when Assessment Date is unchanged
Use Maintenance Date for current eligibility relevant field changes when Assessment Date is unchanged
Regression verify selective date logic prevents improper Maintenance Date usage and preserves finance outcomes
gaps: Status field is "Edge" for id "TC_TS007_003", but no step in Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record.
